snippet.title: Aliens vs. Ghosts Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1609730/Aliens_vs_Ghosts/
Aliens vs. Ghosts is finally out in Early Access! 
The game is still in early stages of development and I plan to add a lot more content including Multiplayer, Upgrades, New Classes, Enemies, Boss Fights, Maps, Game Modes and Achievements!

Support this channel: https://www.patreon.com/sayan23
Discord: https://discord.gg/JxTEXTAh2t
Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCDFQlbO9DkC0L6p1inrk7aw?sub_confirmation=1

Play as an Invader of Earth facing off against hordes of Ghosts in this First Person Shooter. Choose your upgrades, from Portable Nuke Launchers and Giant Robots to fight by your side to UFOs that fly around blasting through ghosts!
